messages:
Sam (CS): Drafting a one-page customer playbook for ramping trials -> production. Goal: reduce cold-starts, give AMs a 2-line script, and capture renewal risk signals. PTAL.

Ivy (AM): Love the try->prod focus. Can we include a lightweight opt-in for customers that want minimal demo latency?

Sam (CS): Yes. Call it 'demo-reserve' flag on tenant metadata. Default off for trials; AMs can enable for high-touch demos.

Rohit (SRE): Ops guidance: tiny priming defaults: trial=3 prefills over 10m; paid-sm=12 over 30m; paid-lg=30 over 60m. Use a warm_batch window then tighten. Minimal pasteable snippet below.

Becca (PM): Also add a renewal signal flow: if AM marks renewal_risk=true after demo, system sets grace_window=14d and reserves a demo slot and outreach cadence. AM updates renewal_score after each touch.

Ivy (AM): AM script (copy): 
- "We ran a short warmup so your demo responds faster." 
- "If you see noisy results or cost surprises we can reduce the warmup or try a smaller model."

Sam (CS): Feedback capture plan: 1) 24h micro-survey (3 quick checkboxes + optional text), 2) daily sampled canonical prompts check, 3) immediate AM escalation if critical-prompt regression > 3%.

Rohit (SRE): Batch/priming snippet for runbook to paste: 
```
priming:
  trial_prefill_count: 3
  trial_window_min: 10
  priming_ttl_min: 5
batching:
  warm_window_ms: 30  # during priming
  steady_window_ms: 8
  max_batch_tokens: 2048
```

Sam (CS): JSON example for AM to flip demo-reserve/grace: 
```
{"tenant_id":"acme-456","demo_reserve":true,"grace_window_days":14,"reserved_demo_pct":5}
```

Becca (PM): Add monitoring & alerting bullets: watch p50/p95/p99 latency, kv_cache_hit%, priming_completion_rate, renewal_score trend. Suggested alerts: p99 > 2x baseline for >2m -> notify SRE+AM; priming_completion_rate < 80% -> auto-retry and tag AM.

Rohit (SRE): Troubleshooting quick hits: low kv_hit% -> check prefix keys and sample cadence; p99 spikes -> check model fallback path; demo_reserve overuse -> inspect routing and reservation config.

Ivy (AM): I'll trial the AM script on two accounts this week and capture verbatim feedback for the handout.

onboard-bot: New doc created: "ramp-playbook-demo-reserve" in #customer-success/docs — please review.

Sam (CS): Thanks! If staging tests pass we'll add this to the onboarding kit and publish a 1-page handout for AMs tomorrow.
